groups.reason: text editing: the prompt of the terminal is its own line editor, which implements the readline keys itself; the page's message box is a browser text box, which edits with the platform's own keys, so the page has no code for them
emacs aliases of the down and up arrows in the prompt's history, the menus and a question; the page has the arrows
repaints a terminal that was scribbled on; a browser repaints its page itself
pages down in the command menu and in the statistics page of the terminal; the page scrolls its panes with the browser's own keys
vi aliases of the down and up arrows in sleipnir watch and sleipnir replay, which choose the agent the views are about; the page has the arrows
aliases of - and + for the speed of sleipnir replay; the page has - and +
vi aliases of Home and End (the start and the end of a recording) in sleipnir replay; the page has Home and End
vi aliases of the left and right arrows (seek ten seconds) in sleipnir replay; the page has the arrows
alias of Space (pause) in sleipnir watch and sleipnir replay; the page has Space
the help overlay of sleipnir watch and sleipnir replay; the page's help is the question mark
leave sleipnir watch or sleipnir replay, which are programs of their own; the page is left by closing its tab
animation off in sleipnir watch and sleipnir replay; the page has /anim and Settings, Appearance, motion, and no key for it

the terminal quits on ctrl+d at an empty prompt, and the Help sheet of the page lists ctrl+d for the same (SHORTCUTS in js/11-data-live.js), but the message box binds no ctrl+d: bind it to the question that closes the session (as ctrl+c twice does), or take it off the sheet
switch to the nth session tab; a terminal program shows one session and has no tabs
renames the focused session tab; the terminal has no tabs, and its session is renamed with a command
open the Settings and Tools views, which have no screen in the terminal chat; the terminal reaches them with slash commands and sleipnir subcommands (see the views dimension)
open the Replay and Sessions views; in the terminal, replay is a program of its own (sleipnir replay) and sessions are listed by /resume
the prefix of the chords to the views of the left rail
chords to views of the page's left rail that the terminal chat has no screen for: Radio, Files, Changes, Checkpoints, Merge, Replay, Sessions, Tools and Settings (see the views dimension)

equivalent.reason: browsers keep ctrl+g on some platforms, so the page binds alt+g to the same cockpit
browsers keep ctrl+t (a new tab), so the page binds alt+t to the same statistics, which are its Cache view
the cockpit: the terminal's page of the team and the page's chord to its Cockpit view
the cache and cost statistics: the terminal's stats page and the page's chord to its Cache view
the Mail view: the page's chord for the key that sleipnir watch has on m
the Board view: the page's chord for the key that sleipnir watch has on b

different_meaning.terminal: kills the text from the cursor to the end of the line, in the prompt's editor
deletes the character after the cursor in the prompt
different_meaning.web: on a focused session tab, asks whether to close it (the text box deletes by itself)

different_meaning.terminal: answers a question in the chat; in sleipnir watch and replay it chooses the cockpit view, 2 3 and 4 the others
different_meaning.web: answers the question in front, as 2 3 and 4 do
